rules.statement: In a partition action, co-owners should be given the lot carrying their improvements only if it does not cause substantial injustice to other co-owners.
rules.supporting_quote: Although, in a partition decree, a co-owner should, whenever possible, be given the lot which carries his improvements, this principle should not be adhered to if, in the process of giving effect to it, substantial injustice is likely to be caused to the other co-owners.

meta.parties: Premathiratne, K.L. v. Elo Fernando, N
